provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: Model gauge k is offset by (k-2)*10 (L8) and only gauges 2..12 are plotted (L14), while measured column k is offset by (k-1)*10 (L23) for k=1..11 -- i.e. model gauge k+1 is compared against measured column k; the mapping is implicit and gauge 1 (h=47 cm per the companion comp_mkskew.m) is dropped.
The measured record's 0.01 s sampling and 20 s start offset (L21) are asserted, not derived from mketa.out; model station sampling interval is whatever sta_00* column 1 contains (L10).
z is filled for k=1..12 including k=1 with negative offset -10 (L5-9) but the k=1 column is never plotted; time is taken from the last gauge only (L10), assuming all stations share one time base.

audit_member_text: Lines 7-10 overwrite gage on each load and then derive time only from the twelfth station, while lines 15-19 plot every z(:,2:12) column against that final station's time. Equal row counts do not guarantee equal timestamps, so differing station time coordinates are silently mispaired; unequal row counts instead fail during z assignment or plotting.
Line 8 assumes every station file has at least two columns and compatible row counts, and line 20 together with lines 22-24 assumes mketa.out has at least 11 columns; neither interface is validated.

The numerical curves use the final station's explicit time column at line 10, whereas reference time_m at line 21 is synthesized with hard-coded 0.01 spacing and a 20-second offset. The file performs no duration/length check before plotting lines 23-24.

The commented clf at line 12 leaves figure and hold state untouched. clear all at line 1 does not reset an existing axes hold state, so if hold was already on, the first plot at line 15 can overlay stale graphics rather than reset the axes.

Station 1 is loaded and stored at lines 5-10 but numerical plotting starts at k=2 on line 14, while the 11 reference columns are plotted as k=1:11 at line 22. This appears to establish a station-2-to-reference-column-1 mapping, but no explicit assertion or metadata verifies that interface.
